content: विबोधः .²1 Awakening, being awake. .²2 Perceiving, discovering. .²3 Intelligence. .²4 Awaking, becoming conscious, one of the 33 or 34 subordinate feelings (or व्यभिचारिभाव) in Rhetoric; निद्रानाशोत्तरं जायमानो बोधो विबोधः <ls>R. G.</ls> .²5 Inattention, absence of mind. .²6 (In drama) The unfolding of the faculties in carrying out an object.
